If Policy A explicitly specifies a parameter's schema default and Policy B implicitly inherits it, their runtime behavior is perfectly identical. Flagging this as a divergence generates a false positive that deceives human reviewers and undermines the utility of the diff. Semantic materialization is mandatory for a policy engine.

The previous models have thoroughly scrubbed the validation gaps (missing schema conformance checks, asymmetrical HARD coverage, domain mismatch) and completeness gaps (missing default materialization).
